/**
   * Optional AutoSync state for this folder (see nsAutoSyncManager).
   * Used to track which messages are queued to be downloaded for offline use.
   * Folders which want to participate in AutoSync can provide this (IMAP,
   * EWS).
   * Folders which don't want/need AutoSync support will return null.
   */
  readonly attribute nsIAutoSyncState autoSyncStateObj;
